Samir (Docs): opened a short PR to fix wording around quota tiers and to add an SDK example for sending the metering header. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/472
Priya (Docs): nice! can we also add a tiny worked example showing cost calc across tiers? customers get tripped up by tiered pricing and free-tier thresholds.
Tom (Billing): yes please. suggestion: show a 2-step calc — apply free-tier, then tiered rate for remainder. use small numbers.
Samir (Docs): draft example added:
# Example
free_tier = 100_000
usage = 350_000
billable = usage - free_tier  # 250k
first_tier_rate = 0.10  # per 1k
second_tier_rate = 0.08 # per 1k
# split 250k into 150k @ first, 100k @ second...
Priya (Docs): perfect. can you also include the PromQL snippet we use for the quota dashboard? saves ops time.
Nina (Analytics): PromQL ok: sum(rate(redwood_token_count_total[5m])) by (customer_id) — also note the dashboard shows token-seconds; billing uses token_count. add a one-line clarification.
Samir (Docs): added both the PromQL and the clarifying sentence. also included curl + python header examples for `x-redwood-usage` as raw and SDK forms.
